activation: No in-game cheat box. The treasury value is changed directly in the save file (default name CAESARXX.SAV), either with a hex editor or DOS's DEBUG.COM.

codes.code: File offset 0x3E, write bytes A8 61 - or in DEBUG.COM, -e 13E A8 61
codes.effect: Sets the treasury to exactly 25,000 denarii.

note: Two versions of this cheat circulate under different tools for what turns out to be the same byte: DEBUG.COM loads a file starting at its default segment offset 0100h, so its memory address 013E is file offset 013E minus 0100h - 0x3E, the hex editor's own answer. The bytes A8 61 read little-endian as 0x61A8, which is 25,000 exactly. A commonly copied variant claims the same offset set to 7F,7F pays out 29,000 denarii, but 0x7F7F is 32,639 - the arithmetic doesn't hold, so only the value that checks out is published here.

sources.title: SierraHelp's cheat-utilities page names the offset; the DEBUG.COM bytes were cross-checked by hand

note: Julius implements only the well/Alt-K/Alt-C/Alt-V sequence; Augustus adds the console and everything after it. Both rows come straight from the source linked below rather than a fan list - the treasury cap and the well-arming step are details most cheat pages online get wrong or leave out. Augustus's console has a longer command set than shown here; these are the ones a player is likeliest to reach for.
